fields.Name: R1 -> S7.3
fields.Description: Gate G5.1 (owner PR 4, phase 5, dataset R1, criterion S7.3): scoring the R1 model on a copy table with DistanceZ renamed is refused with an error naming the scope entity and writes 0 rows, 1 of 1 (FM-15; today the value is read from the training table). The check fills pstruth.Scn_R1Copy with R1's rows (DistanceZ renamed DistanceZRenamed) and shuts both doors to it: (a) a scoring binding of the published R1 unit model on the copy entity is refused at save naming the copy entity, with no binding row left (D4-168: a binding's target is the entity its pipeline's models score); (b) a Score Record Set call of the model without a binding, scoped over 25 of the copy's records, is refused scope-entity-mismatch naming the copy entity before any row is read, its run row stored refused with Written 0 and no Feature Value. No scope maps onto another entity (the entityMapping input is removed, D4-163), so a copy's keys are never scored from the training table.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: A binding of the R1 model on the renamed copy is refused at save, and a no-binding scoring call over the copy is refused scope-entity-mismatch naming the copy entity with 0 rows written, 1 of 1.
